issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a method named checkOrderReady() that orderMeal() should call to attempt serving queued orders, but the reference implementation defines and uses a method named processOrders() instead. This identifier mismatch (checkOrderReady vs. processOrders) can confuse students about which method to implement and expect to be invoked, and may cause mismatch with tests or instructor materials that refer to checkOrderReady().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution's processOrders() method to checkOrderReady(), or add a public checkOrderReady() wrapper that calls processOrders(). Update any references so orderMeal() invokes checkOrderReady() as described in the problem statement.
